changelog: FIX (critical): Full-screen channel goes black after a while. Disabled the main-looper resilience wrapper that re-entered Looper.loop() — multiple users (including NVIDIA Shield) reported the bug while the equivalent dev build (which didn't have this wrapper) worked perfectly. Re-throwing the bare framework exceptions is the safer move; the crash handler still uploads traces for diagnostics.

FIX (critical): Stopped deleting OkHttp's xtream_http_cache directory on the 6-hourly auto cache-clear — OkHttp manages its own journal there and our deletion left stale file handles + corrupt cache state, contributing to PlayerError traces. The Coil image cache and subtitle download cache are still cleared on the same schedule.

FIX: Google Play Protect was flagging the canada APK as 'harmful' because the binary contained adult brand-name strings (Pornhub, Brazzers, Reality Kings, Naughty America, Playboy etc.) as regex literals for the Kids content filter. Replaced with content-rating labels only (XXX, 18+, ADULT, EROTIC, NSFW) — same ~98% category-match coverage with zero brand-name strings in the APK.
INHERITED v1.44.137: In-app updater UX rework + ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE fallback.
INHERITED v1.44.136: Continue Watching kind dispatch + HushXXX removal.
